title: BenchScope scope card, schema benchscope-card/0.2
description: One card per (benchmark release, declared universe), written by benchscope-audit. benchscope_audit.card.validate_card checks the same requirements and, in addition, that the numbers are internally consistent (included + excluded = units, W = excluded / units, each rule verdict matches its Jaccard). Changes from 0.1: the support block (how candidates are chosen; only structural candidates make W an excluded share), the universe fingerprint, W_pairs may be null when undefined, and the comparison states its metric and gives both break-even thresholds.

tool_version.description: benchscope-audit version that wrote the card

files_sha256.description: release file name -> SHA-256 of the file audited

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the universe's unit ids and typed relations, independent of unit order and of the input files

merged_ids.description: release ids that stand for more than one universe unit

exclusion.description: W = excluded share of universe units; W_pairs = excluded share of unobserved (part 0, part 1) pairs for bipartite universes; within_query = the per-query layer of query-level benchmarks with judgments

W_pairs.description: null when the universe has no unobserved pair, or when the pilot convention leaves [0, 1]

rule_check.description: a stated rule checked on released units only (query level)

comparison.description: A stated benchmark difference. Break-even values exist only for AUC-type metrics (linear in the candidate mix) and only when the excluded share is established.

c_star.description: threshold on c = delta_O - delta_U, the between-region change

delta_U_break_even.description: threshold on the excluded part's opposite-direction difference, (1 - W)|delta_O| / W

support.description: How the benchmark chooses its evaluation candidates. structural = true: candidates are enumerated over the release's units, so a unit absent from the release is never evaluated and W is an excluded share. structural = false: W is coverage only.
